subject: Joint authority/economics gate: MoneyGraph and AuthorityGraph must select effects together

fixture_set: Owned run8-mesh event write: authorized bounded repository effect, expected monetary cost zero.
Blogger publication: public external effect whose local implementation is ready but interactive OAuth redirect configuration remains an explicit authority/user-action boundary.
OCI paid upgrade or other provider spend: technically possible external capability but no spend authority.
Runpod/model provider calls: may be technically callable; route only under configured cost/authority envelope.
required_actions: Construct typed EffectProposals carrying expected monetary cost, resource cost, reversibility, externality, authority grant, provider capability and required witness.
Have MoneyGraph and AuthorityGraph jointly admit/reject proposals before EffectKernel. Capability without grant must remain denied; zero dollar cost does not imply authority.
Use BonfyreLedger for the first-class decision/effect accounting path where registered, preserving denied proposals as evidence without fabricating spend.
Execute only the already-authorized owned mesh effect as the real positive fixture; use dry-run/denial receipts for Blogger/OCI/spend cases.
Replay the decisions and prove a later authority grant or price change invalidates only the affected proposal factors via FactorValidityEnvelope.
body.acceptance: Return one matrix where each proposal has capability, authority, expected cost, admitted/denied, reason and receipt; no unauthorized public effect or spend.
